name: Golden Cake
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Cream the butter, add sugar gradually, and yolks of eggs beaten until thick and lemon-colored, and extract.
Mix and sift flour and baking powder, and add alternately with milk to first mixture.
Omit orange extract, add one-half cup nut meat cut in small pieces, and bake in individual tins.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
